title: Step 2: Day-in-the-Life & Playback
body: Running SE-led Day-in-the-Life interviews, mapping current and future workflows, quantifying cost of inaction, and the optional playback
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Prepare DITL interviews for the prioritized use cases.
Map current-state steps, systems, time and bottlenecks.
Draft the future-state workflow with Glean and the time saved.
Decide when a playback session is needed.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-106. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
